Main-table text read but pixels not yet seen. No raw proteomics/transcriptomics reanalysis or clinical reclassification.

23 unrelated people/15 missense variants; ascertainment via GeneMatcher/diagnostic programs. Authors acknowledge recruitment bias, no blinding and only4 patient T-cell sources. Fly knockdown does not reproduce heterozygous missense biology. Locators: [{'source_id': 'main', 'locator': 'Results Identification; Discussion limitations; Methods Study design'}]

Patient5 c.775A>G p.Met259Val is only suspected de novo per Table1 footnote, despite general claim all variants de novo. Figure3A M259V retains substantial protein (~0.8 relativeWT); M259T is strongly depleted. Text incorrectly lists M259V among approximately90% protein reductions; do not transfer that result to patient5. Locators: [{'source_id': 'main', 'locator': 'Table1 footnote and Results protein expression'}, {'source_id': 'fig3', 'locator': 'PanelA HA and PSMC3 bars and blot labels M259T versus M259V'}]

Patient23 c.1147G>A corresponds to E383K in Table1/Fig1/Fig3 labels; prose repeatedly calls it E383L. Actual transcript/version and genomic normalization still need verification. Discussion also refers to M159V whereas results tested M175V. Locators: [{'source_id': 'main', 'locator': 'Structural modeling; Discussion; Table1'}, {'source_id': 'fig1', 'locator': 'E383K label'}, {'source_id': 'fig3', 'locator': 'E383K lanes'}]

Patient13 G262R has little/no proteasome assembly defect but ubiquitin/stress and interferon elevations. Patient21 E305D has assembly/stress/IFN evidence. Other mapped patients lack patient-cell testing here. Neither absence nor presence of one assay establishes clinical truth. Only PKR inhibitor C16 lowers ISG expression after6h in4patient T-cell cultures; no neuronal rescue or human clinical benefit tested. IFN group paragraph calls P=0.0845 significant; that value is not below stated0.05 threshold. Fig8A significance annotation conflicts with prose value; raw data not reanalysed.
